subject: Friends of Medford Athletics Financial Disclosure Request
overview: The committee recognized various student achievements, approved the 2016-17 school calendar, and adopted updated security protocols following recent regional bomb threats. A significant resolution requesting financial records for several athletic booster groups was tabled to a special meeting.

items.title: Minutes and Routine Business
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting and the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Brooks School Mural
items.summary: Approved a request from art teachers to paint a mural in the kindergarten hallway based on the book 'Harold and the Purple Crayon.'

items.title: Science Fair 2016 Report
items.summary: Recognized student winners of the annual science fair and placed the summary report on file.

items.title: SkillsUSA and Environmental Science Program
items.summary: Announced state approval for the Environmental Science program and approved an overnight trip for SkillsUSA state qualifiers.

items.title: 2016-17 School Calendar
items.summary: Approved the next school year's calendar, which features a start date before Labor Day and new mandated professional development days.

items.title: Online Payments and Bus Routing Systems
items.summary: Received an update on the usage of online payment portals and the implementation of the TransFinder bus routing software.

items.title: Charter School Update
items.summary: Discussed funding impacts of charter school expansions and tabled a resolution regarding the charter school cap pending an ethics review.

items.title: Financial Literacy Report
items.summary: Reviewed student debt statistics and discussed an upcoming event with State Treasurer Deborah Goldberg.

items.title: School Security Protocols
items.summary: Adopted updated emergency response and threat assessment protocols following a series of recent regional bomb threats.

items.title: Friends of Medford Athletics Resolution
items.summary: Tabled a resolution seeking bank records and signer information for three athletic booster groups and moved the follow-up meeting to the high school library for filming.

items.title: Meeting Postponement
items.summary: Voted to postpone the meeting scheduled for March 21 to March 28.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Entered executive session to discuss legal and negotiation matters.
